title: My Daughter Forged My POA, Stole $340K & Abandoned Me. So I Watched Her License Suspended.
description: My daughter swore to be my power of attorney, then forged a durable POA, drained my entire $340K IRA, and bought a condo that banned seniors. I exposed the fraud, won a $410K judgment, and now I live in that condo teaching nursing students about family fraud. #JusticeServed #FamilyBetrayal #FinancialAbuse
thumb_text: SHE STOLE MY $340K IRA. NOW I LIVE IN HER CONDO.
pinned_comment: Could you ever look your daughter in the eye after she drained your entire $340K IRA and bought a condo that bans seniors? Share your story in the comments.
